goals: Verify the DeleteWorkshopFiles API successfully deletes specified files from a workshop, ensuring correct API response, updated database records, and accurate file storage state.
activities: Clean the workshop test environment.
Insert a new workshop into the database.
Create a text file associated with the workshop in storage.
Create an image file associated with the workshop in storage.
Add both created files to the workshop's metadata in the database.
Construct a DELETE API request URL to delete the first file, including an invalid parameter.
Send a DELETE request to the API.
Parse the JSON response from the API.
Update the local workshop object state to reflect the deletion of the first file.
Assert that the API response status code is 200.
Assert that the API response Content-Type header is application/json.
Assert that the API response body status field is 200.
Assert that the API response body message indicates success.
Assert that the API response body data matches the expected workshop data.
Assert that the API response body detail confirms the deletion of the first file.
Verify the workshop data in the database.
Verify that the first file does not exist in storage.
Verify that the second file still exists in storage.
